normalization_policy: Original spreadsheets remain the source of truth and are not overwritten.
Whitespace, line breaks and obvious mechanical spelling/formatting errors are normalized only in derived fields.
Source wording is preserved in source observations.
Minor-course canonical titles use the exact minor-workbook title when a stable course code is present.
Conflicting values across batches/sheets are preserved and flagged rather than silently reconciled.
TBA/TBD/New/DON’T KNOW are treated as unresolved placeholders, not valid stable course codes.
Slash-separated course-code entries are preserved as paired/alternative source entries and are not collapsed into one course.
L/T/P/C are stored explicitly as lecture/tutorial/practical/credit fields and also represented as LTPC metadata.
validation_notes: Original spreadsheets remain unchanged and are the source of truth.

All source-linked normalized rows were checked against the uploaded spreadsheets; differences observed in source text are formatting/whitespace normalization unless explicitly recorded as a variant/conflict.
COMP401 is not a canonical course entity because the source occurrence has no title; it is represented as a reference-only unresolved code.
Derived canonical titles may correct clear mechanical errors, while every raw title variant remains preserved in source_observations/title_aliases.
Prerequisite variants are not silently reconciled; substantive differences remain flagged.
The DATA405 prerequisite whitespace-only variation is not treated as a substantive conflict.
